capabilities: publish the current note to AmpliFlow with one command
configure AmpliFlow tenant, email, and password in settings
extras: Manual installation only (download release and copy to plugins folder); no screenshots or usage examples beyond command steps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to AmpliFlow, so sharing notes there required manual copying.

relations.evidence: allows you to publish your notes directly to AmpliFlow as markdown pages

requires.name: AmpliFlow tenant with email and password

summary: Publishing plugin that sends the current note to AmpliFlow as a markdown page via a command palette command.
